'''Nateba Kerr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who handled payments for the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:NymGuardTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Nateba Kerr]]
Nateba Kerr was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Nateba Kerr spawned under the generic "nym_guard" template, his appearance was randomized under one of four possible depictions. He could appear as a [[Human/Legends|Human]] female, a Human male, a male [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]], or a male [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]]. The [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Kerr as male, however the [[canon]]ical [[Species/Legends|species]] cannot be definitively determined in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity. In another quest given by [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]], the player was tasked with locating a [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] named [[Nateba Kurr]]. Despite the similar name, there was nothing in the quest dialogue to suggest that they were the same person.<ref name="AED" />
